project.name: Numou Security - Aggregator
project.description:
Phase 1 security layer (Docs/Plan/base01.md §16, §P1-17, §P1-18).
Two deliberately distinct questions:
authentication Who are you? authorization What are you allowed to do?
Authorization is contextual - user, tenant, resource, action and context - because one user may belong to several tenants and "Can John update Shipment #123 for Tenant ABC?" is the real question. Business audit is separate from technical logging and lives here as an append-only aggregate.
